svg.title: Figure 3-4. DFMEA failure chains — sheet 1 of 3 (DFM)
svg.desc: DFMEA failure chains, sheet 1 of 3 (DFM rev 0.11): failure modes DFM-001 to DFM-009 (10 failure modes, 12 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
